description: This file contains React functional components for a community page, including a list of topics, topic details with replies, and a form for creating new topics. It interacts with an API service for fetching and manipulating forum data.

methods.name: CommunityHome()
methods.description: Component that displays a list of community topics, fetched from the API.

methods.name: TopicDetail
methods.description: Component that displays details of a selected topic including its replies and allows posting a new reply.

methods.name: NewTopic
methods.description: Component that provides a form to create a new discussion topic.
